text.title: Migration Impact Mapping Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on migration scope, on whether live traffic or persisted data already holds the old format, and on whether a persisted schema or published contract changes — to the full map with expand/contract phases, a reduced seam-only map, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the proposed migration touch more than ~30% of files, or cross a critical runtime boundary (persistence layer, published API, framework or language runtime)?

conclusion.verdict: skip; a single-module refactor or one-library swap is served by a lightweight ADR, not an impact map

branch.question: Is there production traffic, or persisted data and in-flight messages, already holding the old format?

conclusion.verdict: skip; pre-launch there is no rollback surface to map — migrate directly and revisit once traffic exists

branch.question: Does the migration change a persisted schema or a contract other deployables read, so old and new formats must coexist across a deploy?

conclusion.verdict: apply the full map: counted blast radius, named seam, expand → dual-write → backfill → read-new → contract phases with reconciliation, and a declared point of no return
apply a reduced map: counted blast radius, a named seam with its selection mechanism, and trunk-gated increments; the expand/contract and dual-write sections do not apply
